intro.text: A member of the Set working on captives taken from Bilming.

items.text: In 348 Fion's team was running Hemalurgic experiments on political dissidents seized from Bilming. As Autonomy's army began to arrive, Gave Entrone demanded results; disappointed, he staked his hopes on the Community project and ordered the team to kill the captives. Its leader had Fion announce a priority-one evacuation of loyalists to the caverns under Bilming.
